theory/INTERFACE_THEORY_V0_1.md.normalized_content: Defines class F,target L,interface O, observation equivalence, factorization, linear kernel/Jacobian criteria, minimal antichains, resources and failure modes; explicitly denies universal IQ/correctability/etc.

theory/DEFINITIONS.md.normalized_content: Defines systems, targets, interfaces, equivalence, factorization, kernels, Jacobian local condition, refinement/minimality/cost, approximate/stochastic/temporal interfaces and gate declaration.

theory/NOTATION.md.normalized_content: Defines target/index dependence, stochastic distribution equality, antichains, temporal design, hidden temporal modes and C_rev^{F,I}.

theorems/FACTORIZATION_CRITERION.md.normalized_content: Identifiability iff observation equivalence refines target equivalence iff L factors through O; linear kernel criterion proven; nonlinear Jacobian condition local/necessary; stochastic extension scoped.

theorems/MINIMAL_INTERFACE_THEOREM.md.normalized_content: For finite interface family with at least one sufficient interface, at least one minimal sufficient interface exists; minima generally form an antichain; cost lower bound is conditional.

theorems/APPROXIMATE_IDENTIFIABILITY.md.normalized_content: Defines ambiguity A_L(epsilon,O,F); Lipschitz factorization gives A_L<=K epsilon; sample error sigma/sqrt(n) is conditional on an identifiable interface; no universal usefulness claim.
